title: PMT combsweep: 2304 of 2304 on the corpus that pinned the combine
upstream_status_verbatim: NUM-L | M1 (the catalogue row that carries this figure is still open)
status_plain: PMT scored 2,304 of 2,304 against live Excel on the combsweep corpus. The corpus is the one the combine fix was pinned against -- the source says so in as many words, "this is what pinned the combine" -- so the score is in-sample and the corpus was the repair's own target. The same brief names the separate held-out corpus one line earlier, and the before/after measurement that justified the landing puts the held-out gate at 56 per cent, not 100. The corpus is also fv=0 only, a sub-lane of PMT's input space rather than PMT's input space. STEWARD DECISION SD-5 publishes this figure with corpus_was_repair_target true and requires it to render inside the same visual unit as PMT's open divergence state and as the production replay in which PMT scores 2,506 of 4,040 and the whole corpus scores 60.5 per cent. If either mechanism is dropped this record becomes an overclaim.

reader_warning: Do not read 2304/2304 as PMT matching Excel. It is a full pass on the corpus the fix was pinned against, restricted to fv=0. PMT's numeric state is open: the production replay of the Phase-E corpus scores PMT at 2,506 of 4,040 and the corpus as a whole at 3,117 of 5,154. This record must never render without EV-FIN-0004 (PMT's open divergence) and EV-FIN-0001 with EV-FIN-0002 (the 60.5 per cent production replay) in the same visual unit.
